A few quick answers

How do I change lanes?

Tap the left or right side of the screen, or swipe. You can replay the tutorial from the game's settings to practice lane changes and close calls.

Can you restore my coins or unlocked car looks?

The current beta stores progress on your device and has no game account or cloud save. We cannot recover a lost local save through an account. Clearing app storage or reinstalling can remove your progress; a device backup may restore an older copy.

How do I delete my game data?

Use Android Settings → Apps → Edge Rush → Storage → Clear storage (or Clear all data). This resets progress and settings. Clearing the cache alone does not reset saves. See the full deletion instructions, including device backups.

Why does a reward screen say TEST AD?

It is an in-game simulation used to test optional reward flows in internal development builds. It does not request a live ad from an advertising network. A future build with real ads will have an updated privacy policy and the required configuration.

Can I get a public download link?

There is no public download link to share yet. The game is being prepared for TapTap International; this page will be updated when a verified public listing is available.

What if I have a privacy request?

Email wkeongg@gmail.com. For a support-email deletion request, identify the conversation from the relevant email address. For local game data, follow the device deletion steps above. Read the privacy policy for the current beta's scope.
